title: When should you use a tutela action?
excerpt: Situations in which a tutela action can be an effective tool to protect your rights.

image.alt: Judge's gavel on a wooden desk

body:
The tutela action, established in article 86 of the Colombian Constitution, allows you to ask a judge for the immediate protection of a fundamental right when an authority or, in certain cases, a private party violates or threatens it.

## When does it apply?

- When there is no other effective legal remedy.
- When, even if another remedy exists, it is used to prevent irreparable harm.

## Common cases

- Denial of treatments, medicines or medical appointments.
- No response to a petition.
- Impact on minimum subsistence.
- Violation of due process.

## How does it work?

Anyone can file it, without a lawyer. The judge must decide within 10 business days (Decree 2591 of 1991). The decision can be appealed and, if it is not complied with, a contempt proceeding can be started.
